app_identity.name: SweetOClock
app_identity.concept: Haute Artisanal Indian Sweet Shop (Mithai Storefront & Admin)
app_identity.archetype: Organic & Earthy Warm Artisanal (Saffron, Pistachio, Ghee Gold, Rice Paper)

theme_strategy.rationale: Indian mithai requires rich, appetizing warm tones (saffron, ghee gold, pistachio green) with ivory rice-paper backgrounds. The admin panel utilizes a sleek modern slate dark/light contrast for data density.

typography.headline_rules: Use font-serif tracking-tight with warm terracotta or dark charcoal color. Never use generic Inter for titles.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-bold text-stone-900 leading-tight
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-semibold text-stone-900 tracking-tight

header_nav.style: Sticky header with backdrop blur bg-[#FAF6F0]/85 border-b border-amber-900/10 z-50
header_nav.elements: Brand logo with golden sweet icon, Navigation links (Our Mithai, Process & Purity, Order Tracking), Cart Button with badge counter, Admin Portal switch

hero_section.left_content: Artisanal badge, Handcrafted Laddoo & Khajur Fudge headline, Per-kg pricing callout, Quick Add buttons, Pure Desi Ghee guarantee pill
hero_section.right_content: Hero image container with rounded-2xl overflow, subtle saffron halo blur background glow, organic floating detail card

products_section.layout: Responsive Bento grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8
products_section.product_card_style: bg-white border border-stone-200 hover:border-amber-400 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 rounded-2xl p-6 relative flex flex-col justify-between

featured_products.name: Besan & Gond Laddoo
featured_products.desc: Slow-roasted gram flour in 100% pure Desi Ghee, studded with crunchy almonds & edible gum.

featured_products.name: Royal Khajur & Dry Fruit Fudge
featured_products.desc: Rich dates crushed with premium pistachios, cashews, and saffron strands. Zero added refined sugar.

featured_products.name: Shahi Royal Assorted Box
featured_products.desc: Curated selection of hand-rolled Laddoos, Date Fudges, and Kaju Katli wrapped in gold-foiled artisanal box.

layout_and_components.weight_selector: Interactive weight chip buttons: 250g (0.25x), 500g (0.5x), 1kg (1x), 2kg (2x) with auto-calculated live total
layout_and_components.cart_drawer: Slide-over right panel with item quantities, weight breakdown, subtotal, GST, delivery fee, and Express Guest Checkout button

guest_checkout.payment_options: Razorpay Mock / Integration trigger + UPI / Card simulation
guest_checkout.flow: No login required. Direct instant purchase.

order_tracking.visual_timeline: 4-stage status tracker (Placed -> Paid -> Packed -> Shipped -> Delivered) with Shiprocket AWBS / Courier detail pill

admin_dashboard.sidebar: Dark slate (#0F172A) with logo, Products CRUD tab, Orders Management tab, Analytics summary
admin_dashboard.order_management: Table view with customer name, phone, address, total amount, payment status (Razorpay ID), order status dropdown (Paid, Packed, Shipped, Delivered), Actions (Push to Shiprocket, Resend Invoice PDF)

testing_and_data_ids.mandatory_rule: All buttons, inputs, links, cards, tabs, and status badges MUST include data-testid

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Cormorant Garamond & Outfit fonts into public/index.html or index.css for authentic mithai aesthetic.
Ensure background color `#FAF6F0` is applied on storefront body for warm paper texture feel.
Implement guest checkout without enforcing login or registration.
Include Razorpay payment simulation modal/trigger with transaction ID generation.
Provide downloadable HTML/PDF order invoice generator upon checkout completion and in admin panel.
Build Order Tracking tool that allows users to view order status by entering Order ID + Phone number.
In Admin Panel, allow state transitions (Paid -> Packed -> Shipped -> Delivered) and Shiprocket push simulation with tracking ID generation.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes attached.
